legal.$readme: Quick stub Privacy + Terms. Replace with your lawyer-reviewed copy when you have it. lastUpdated is shown on each page.

privacy.heading: What we collect
privacy.body: Account email, review platform credentials (encrypted at rest), and the public reviews + replies that flow through the product. We do not collect personal information from reviewers beyond what they post publicly.

privacy.heading: What we do with it
privacy.body: We use it to draft replies on your behalf and surface them in your dashboard. We never sell data and we never share it with third parties for advertising.

privacy.heading: Where it lives
privacy.body: Postgres in the US (AWS us-east-1). Encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. Backups retained for 30 days.

privacy.heading: Who can see it
privacy.body: Members of your A3 Brands organization, with row-level scoping by dealership. A3 Brands engineering can access production for support purposes; every access is logged in the audit trail.

privacy.heading: Your rights
privacy.body: You can export all your data at any time, and request deletion - we'll permanently remove it within 30 days. GDPR and CCPA requests honored.

terms.heading: The service
terms.body: A3 Brands AI Review Response ingests reviews from connected platforms, drafts replies via AI, and publishes approved replies on your behalf. The service is provided as-is on a subscription basis.

terms.heading: Your responsibilities
terms.body: You are responsible for the accuracy of replies you approve and for the credentials you connect. You must comply with each review platform's terms of service.

terms.heading: AI output disclaimer
terms.body: AI-drafted replies are suggestions. You are the final approver. We are not liable for replies that you (or your team) approve and publish.

terms.heading: Subscription + cancellation
terms.body: Plans bill monthly per rooftop. Cancel any time before the next renewal - no refunds for partial months. We'll export your data on request.

terms.heading: Liability
terms.body: Our total liability is capped at the amount you've paid us in the prior 12 months. We aren't liable for indirect or consequential damages.

terms.heading: Changes
terms.body: We may update these terms with 30 days' notice. Continued use after that constitutes acceptance.

sections.heading: Encryption
sections.body: All third-party credentials are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. TLS 1.3 enforced for everything in transit.

sections.heading: Authentication
sections.body: Argon2id password hashing. Optional Google SSO. JWT sessions expire after 14 days. Per-org RBAC: AGENCY_ADMIN, GM, MARKETING_DIRECTOR, RESPONSE_AGENT roles.

sections.heading: Tenant isolation
sections.body: Every tenant-scoped query carries organizationId. Application-level guards plus Postgres row-level scoping prevent cross-tenant reads.

sections.heading: Audit logging
sections.body: Every approve, reject, regenerate, publish, and member action is logged with actor + timestamp. Logs retained for 12 months and exportable on request.

sections.heading: Hosting + backups
sections.body: Vercel (compute) + managed Postgres in AWS us-east-1. Daily encrypted backups with 30-day retention. RPO 24h / RTO 4h for the production tier.

sections.heading: Compliance
sections.body: SOC2 Type II in progress (audit scheduled Q3 2026). GDPR and CCPA compliant. DPA available on request for Growth + Agency tiers.

sections.heading: Responsible disclosure
sections.body: Found a vulnerability? Email security@a3brands.com. We respond within 24 hours and credit researchers in our security.md.

faq.a: Only if you want it to. By default, every reply goes to a GM inbox for one-click approval. You can set per-dealership rules - e.g. auto-publish 5-star reviews with >90% AI confidence, hold everything else for approval.

faq.q: What happens with negative or legal-risk reviews?
faq.a: The AI flags them and routes them to escalation instead of generating a public reply. A human (GM or legal) sees them first, with the matched risk keywords highlighted. No bad reply ever ships without sign-off.
Most dealerships are live within a week. We handle the OAuth connections to Google, Yelp, Facebook, BBB, DealerRater, and Cars.com on the kickoff call. Your team only does the tone-of-voice review.

faq.q: Does it integrate with our CRM or CDP?
faq.a: Yes - we push review + response activity into your CRM via webhook (Salesforce, HubSpot, VinSolutions, DealerSocket all supported). Two-way sync available on Growth and Agency plans.

faq.q: What if the AI writes something wrong?
faq.a: Two safety nets: (1) GMs see every reply before it ships, with an edit textarea right there; (2) the AI flags low-confidence drafts and refuses to generate for anything resembling a legal complaint. The audit log shows who approved what and when.
